fields.display_title: This paper discusses a method to make spiking networks more relevant to latency-sensitive applications on the edge. I believe the authors' method is relevant to this problem, but doesn't feel like it uncovers anything fundamentally new.  It is an engineering solution to a specific problem; and spiking networks are not a widely used method at the edge currently.
